thought.text: Xvfb siap. Sekarang jalankan browser headed di dalam Xvfb — Turnstile akan render normal.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && sed -i 's|b = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)|b = p.chromium.launch(headless=False, args=["--no-sandbox"])|' amsniff.py && Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1280x900x24 >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 240 python3 amsniff.py 2>&1 | head -30

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && sed -i 's|b = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)|b = p.chromium.launch(headless=False, args=[\"--no-sandbox\"])|' amsniff.py && Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1280x900x24 >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 240 python3 amsniff.py 2>&1 | head -30", "summary": "Run sniffer headed under Xvfb", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "timeout": 320}
